title: OrgAnchor Root Authority Migration v2
description: A migration payload requiring separate old-authority authorization and new-authority acceptance over the same payload. Detached signature envelope versions follow their respective signing authorities.
$comment: Runtime validation must check both canonical authority hashes, distinct old/new hashes, effective_at >= issued_at, no post-quantum downgrade, predecessor hash and sequence continuity across the migration chain, and both complete-authorizer thresholds. Independently trusted authority pins and publication-time evidence are verifier inputs, not facts established by this schema or the embedded authorities. Register the referenced v1 and v2 authority schemas by their $id values for offline validation.

sequence.description: Monotonic migration sequence; migrate create increments the supplied predecessor's sequence, or starts at 1.

previous_migration_hash.description: Canonical SHA-256 digest of the preceding migration, or null when no predecessor is supplied.
